intro: What changed in each version of Office Ping, newest first.

changes.text: A new chat message plays a short, soft *blip-blip*, quieter than a ping and easy to tell apart from it.
No sound for the chat you already have open, for chats you've muted, or while you're *In a meeting* or on *Do not disturb*. Several messages in a row make one sound.

releases.title: A louder ping sound and security updates

changes.text: Pings are much louder and easier to recognize: a rising three-note bell for normal pings and a sharp alarm for urgent ones.
Pings that arrived before you'd clicked in the Office Ping window made no sound. Now one click anywhere in the window turns sound on for the day.
Updated the software Office Ping is built on to fix known security issues.
**Messages** in the sidebar and phone tab bar: a one-to-one chat for things that don't need an answer this minute.
Start a chat from **People** (**Message**) or with **New message**. See *typing…* while they write and **Seen** once they've read it.
On a computer, a **Messages** bar in the bottom-right corner keeps your chats one click away on every page.
**Ping** at the top of a chat sends that person a ping when it can't wait. The bell mutes a chat.

releases.title: Your status, quick replies and urgent reminders

changes.text: Set a status (*In a meeting*, *Do not disturb*, *Out for lunch*, *Away from desk*) with an end time. In a meeting or on Do not disturb, normal pings wait quietly in your Inbox.
Quick replies when you acknowledge a ping, shown to the sender straight away and in History.
An urgent ping nobody has acknowledged after 5 minutes pops up again, and the sender is told.
Press **Ctrl + K** or **/** to ping someone from any page. History has search and filters; admins can export it as CSV.
Office Ping can open by itself when your computer starts (see *Help*).
HR and admins choose which three templates appear on everyone's Overview.
A phone Overview that fits on one screen, with people, quick messages and Send together.
Repeated pings collapse into one (*Nudge ×8*) and can be acknowledged together.
Limits on how often pings can be sent, and sign-in is locked for a while after repeated wrong passwords.

releases.title: Pop-up pings, Help and a new look

changes.text: A ping now pops up in the middle of the screen and stays until you click **Acknowledge** or **Later**. Urgent pings jump the queue.
The **Help** page: a user manual with animated demos, and a guided tour (**Show me around**).
The TGF Sunbeam look, and every page now works on phones and tablets.
Pings no longer show up more than once, and acknowledging on one device clears the pop-up on the others.
Send a ping to a person or a group, normal or urgent, and see when it's delivered and acknowledged.
Inbox, History, groups and message templates, with desktop notifications.
Change your own password; admins can reset someone else's.
